title: Pure HERO (Omni-HERO)
summary: Pure Omni-HERO strategy uniting all branches of the HERO family (Elemental, Vision, Masked, Destiny, and Xtra) alongside the 2026 support wave and generic staples. By chaining searchers through Miracle Ejector, Vision HERO Faris, and Elemental HERO Stratos, the deck fluidly navigates between Mask Changes and Fusion Summons to field multi-negate, floodgate, and OTK boards.

summary.title: Starters
points: Miracle Ejector sends Neo-Spacian Grand Mole from Deck to GY to Special Summon itself, then searches any Spell or Trap that mentions an Elemental HERO (such as EN Shuffle, Soul Union, or H.E.R.O. Flash!).
Vision HERO Faris discards any HERO monster to Special Summon itself from hand and places Vision HERO Increase face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap.
Vision HERO Increase tributes a HERO monster to Special Summon itself from the Spell & Trap Zone and Special Summons Vision HERO Vyon directly from your Deck.
Elemental HERO Stratos on Normal or Special Summon searches any HERO monster from your Deck to hand, or destroys Spells/Traps up to the number of other HEROes you control.

summary.title: Opening: Vision HERO Faris + HERO Monster
steps: Activate Vision HERO Faris in hand, discarding a HERO monster (such as Shadow Mist or Malicious) to Special Summon itself.
Place Vision HERO Increase into your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap.
Tribute Faris to Special Summon Increase, then trigger Increase to Special Summon Vision HERO Vyon from your Deck.
Trigger Vyon on summon to send Elemental HERO Shadow Mist from Deck to GY, triggering Shadow Mist to search Elemental HERO Liquid Soldier (or Stratos).
Banish Faris from your GY with Vyon to search Polymerization from your Deck.
Link Summon Xtra HERO Cross Crusader, revives a Destiny HERO, and tributes it to search Destiny HERO - Plasma or Masked HERO extenders.
Faris, Furnace, and Cross Crusader lock your Extra Deck into HERO monsters for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Masked HERO Dark Law banishes every single card sent to the opponent's GY instead, and banishes 1 random card from their hand whenever they add a card from Deck to hand outside the Draw Phase.

Destiny HERO - Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer reduces opposing monsters' ATK, destroys a card on each field as a Quick Effect on either turn, and revives a Destiny HERO from GY during the next Standby Phase.
Destiny HERO - Plasma negates the activated effects of all face-up monsters your opponent controls while on the field, and equips an opponent's monster once per turn to gain half its ATK.
Elemental HERO Absolute Zero destroys all monsters the opponent controls whenever it leaves the field, effortlessly combined with Mask Change into Masked HERO Acid or Dark Law for a total board wipe.
Masked HERO Atomic is a 2026 FIRE Masked HERO that revives a Masked HERO and Sets a Change Quick-Play Spell during each End Phase.
Elemental HERO Thunder Giant - Voltic Thunder destroys every other card on the field when the opponent controls more cards than you.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mask Change targets a HERO monster you control to send it to the GY and Special Summon a Masked HERO with the same Attribute from your Extra Deck at Quick-Play speed.
EN Shuffle shuffles an Elemental HERO or Neo-Spacian you control into the Deck to Special Summon an Elemental HERO from your Deck with a different name, and banishes itself from GY to draw 1 card.

Favorite Contact Special Summons a HERO Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck by shuffling its materials from hand, field, GY, or banishment back into the Deck, and prevents the summoned monster from returning to the Extra Deck.
Soul Union boosts a monster's ATK and enables Fusion Summons from the GY, while Hero's Rule 1: Five Freedoms banishes five cards from either GY.

allow.Neo-Spacian Grand Mole: Miracle Ejector's cost: it sends a Neo-Spacian from the Deck to summon itself.
